dialogue_texts: I don't know what the heck happened and how my mind got taken over again...
I had to rough you up a bit, but I managed to blast that weird junk right off you.
I want to hurry and escape this place, but...
Hold your horses. You aren't going anywhere until you tell me who's behind this.
A mansion this fancy must be hiding some serious answers.
With your intervention, you should help most of Gensokyo's population return to their uncursed forms.
Sounds like a pain, but if beating up the mastermind fixes everyone up, that's exactly what I'm gonna do.
I really want to help you, but I somehow can't!
If you can't do it, leave it to the queen.
Just point me toward where the big boss is hiding, and I'll handle the rest.
Hey, don't look at me like that.
If you've got a problem with me breaking your toys, you shouldn't have brought 'em into my territory.
If you thought I could give up my princess to you, you're dumber than me!
All the time I spent powering up my greatest invention will pay off in a big way!
I will continue to take over Gensokyo's people for myself! They will be forced to trust the Order!
Oh, looks like I definitely have to leave now!
A tag-team match, huh? Fine by me!
I don't care if there are two of you - my Master Spark can blast a whole crowd away at once!
If you think a couple of cheap parlor tricks can stop the queen, you're in for a flashy wake-up call!
If you thought Berenice Grieg was enough, turns out she has another subordinate and is responsible for this!
A hidden leader? Heh, standard villain stuff.
Quit stalling and tell me where this boss is hiding so I can go collect my reward.
That's right. Berenice has... a twin sister!
A twin sister? Wow, a double dose of trouble.
No wonder their plans felt twice as annoying as usual.
When Berenice broke into this place, I attempted to fight her off with my own danmaku.
But then she cursed me with this glohm stuff!
It caused me to act antagonistically, and you managed to come in earlier and undo the curse.
Don't sweat the small stuff. Breaking weird curses and dodging stray danmaku is what I do best.
Just stay put so you don't get zapped again.
Not too long thereafter, the other one came in for revenge and cursed me again...
Along with many other individuals in Gensokyo!
Defeating Berenice gave Veronica even more power to avenge her!
So taking down one sister just fueled the other for revenge? How tedious.
I don't care how much juice she's got now; she's still getting blasted.
I can't risk being cursed a third time, and you are my only hope for ending this madness!
